calibrated_proba_duplicate.description: Positive-class probability after artifact calibration, or null when the loaded artifact has no probability calibrator.
calibrated_proba_duplicate.title: Calibrated Proba Duplicate

decision_threshold.description: Probability threshold used to compute is_duplicate. Request threshold wins over artifact metadata; artifact metadata wins over QUORABUST_DECISION_THRESHOLD.
decision_threshold.title: Decision Threshold

decision_threshold_source.description: Source of the threshold used for this request: request, artifact metadata, environment, or default.
decision_threshold_source.title: Decision Threshold Source

features.description: Optional per-pair model input feature values when `explain=true`. These are feature values, not causal explanations.
features.title: Features

is_duplicate.description: Thresholded duplicate decision for each pair, same order as the request lists.
is_duplicate.title: Is Duplicate

proba_duplicate.description: Effective probability used for the thresholded decision. This remains the backward-compatible response field and equals calibrated_proba_duplicate when available, otherwise raw_proba_duplicate.
proba_duplicate.title: Proba Duplicate

probability_source.description: Whether proba_duplicate is raw or calibrated artifact output.
probability_source.title: Probability Source

raw_proba_duplicate.description: Positive-class probability from the base classifier before calibration. It is a model probability output, not necessarily a calibrated probability.
raw_proba_duplicate.title: Raw Proba Duplicate

variant.description: Scoring variant (a or b) after A/B fallback rules.
variant.title: Variant

PredictOut.title: PredictOut

get.description: Returns allowlisted metadata for loaded variants. Local artifact paths and training CSV paths are intentionally omitted. If `QUORABUST_API_KEY` is configured, send it in the `X-Quorabust-API-Key` header. Every response includes an `X-Request-ID` UUID for support and log correlation.

post.description: Scores one or more question pairs. Optional header `X-Quorabust-Variant: b` selects the B artifact when configured. Set query parameter `explain=true` to return input feature values. Set `threshold` to override the duplicate decision cutoff for this request. Deployments can configure `QUORABUST_API_KEY` and `QUORABUST_MAX_BATCH_SIZE`, `QUORABUST_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH`, and `QUORABUST_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` for access control and bounded work. Every response includes an `X-Request-ID` UUID for support and log correlation.

parameters.description: Optional probability cutoff for is_duplicate. Defaults to artifact metadata decision_threshold when present, otherwise QUORABUST_DECISION_THRESHOLD or 0.5.
parameters.name: threshold

schema.description: Optional probability cutoff for is_duplicate. Defaults to artifact metadata decision_threshold when present, otherwise QUORABUST_DECISION_THRESHOLD or 0.5.
schema.title: Threshold

parameters.description: A/B variant: `a` (default) or `b` if a second model is loaded.
parameters.name: X-Quorabust-Variant
